title: Landing Page by @dakshpixelup: Shipping 100+ landing pages is not a flex, Starting with an already ex
notes:
Shipping 100+ landing pages is not a flex, Starting with an already existing, poor performing page and improving its clarity, messaging and conversions is a much bigger flex. We recently partnered with Sully's team to audit and improve their website experience. - Rewrote and restructured existing pages for clarity - Fixed the pages that diluted their message - Launched new strategic pages where gaps existed It lead to better messaging, clearer positioning, more ROI.

Designer: @dakshpixelup. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
